content:
mona: Quick bring-up note for nova12b int6 run. Did a 600-sample smoke across multi-turn customer support and long-form synthesis. Putting high-levels here.
rahul: paste numbers plz.
mona: perf + econ first:
```
int6 throughput: 740 tok/s (fp16 baseline nova12b: 460 tok/s)
avg latency p50: 68ms -> 44ms
unit_cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.0019 (int6) vs $0.0030 (fp16) -> ~36% savings
```
claire: that's attractive. quality?
mona: overall METEOR-like score on paraphrase/summary set: fp16=0.428, int6=0.415 (-1.3 pts). Long extractive EM: fp16=0.78, int6=0.75 (-3 pts). Short QA and instruction-following unchanged.
rahul: where do regressions live? any pattern?
mona: concentrated on long spans with dense entity copying and on a small set of disfluent generations in multi-turn threads. token-level ppl: ppl_fp16=6.9 vs ppl_int6=7.8 on regressions.
claire: any cheap mitigations tried? temperature tweak, bias, or prompt-rewrite?
mona: tried prompt priming + entity-keying (prepend entity list) which recovered ~0.6 of the delta in a handful of cases. Also tried final-layer rescale (+0.015) which helped 40% of fails but hurt some short-form outputs.
rahul: Could we do traffic-based hybrid: default int6, route long/document synth to fp16? Need unit-econ calc for product.
claire: also consider "signal-first" castback: run int6 and compute a cheap quality proxy (per-token entropy or repeat ngram rate) in-stream; if proxy crosses threshold, cast to fp16 and continue. That keeps most cost savings.
mona: rough math: if 18% traffic qualifies as long and we route those to fp16, blended cost = 0.18*$0.0030 + 0.82*$0.0019 = $0.00221 (~26% vs baseline). If signal-castback triggers 6% of tokens, blended cost ~= $0.00198 (~34% saving).
infra-bot: capacity-check: nova12b fp16 pools headroom: us-east 8%, eu-west 7%. Predicted uplift if 18% long-route: +15% on fp16 pools.
rahul: ops-bot can we simulate castback mid-gen KV migration complexity?
ops-bot: KV migration runtime exists but cross-precision castback needs careful cache reinitialization. Estimated infra work: 6 dev-weeks for a robust mid-gen castback path + tests. Short-term we can implement length-based routing (config-only) in <1 week.
claire: product tradeoffs: length-based routing is simple but may overprovision fp16 capacity; signal-castback is better econ but needs infra. For GTN, recommend length-based routing as an MVP and schedule castback as v1.1.
rahul: agree. Also add a canary flag: start with int6 default, shadow fp16 for 3% traffic to measure live quality delta before any routing change.
mona: action items:
- mona: run 3k-sample long-form sweep with shadow fp16 and length-routing sim; capture per-slice deltas (ETA 8h)
- infra: capacity sim for 18% long-route and cost to reserve small fp16 buffer (ETA 24h)
- infra: rough estimation for castback dev work (ETA 2d)
- product: draft GTN note with blended econ + UX latency expectations (ETA tomorrow)
rahul: add metric thresholds: max allowable ROUGE-like delta 0.8 absolute on key slices; if exceeded abort rollout.
claire: add alarm: hallucination-rate delta >1% triggers rollback.
infra-bot: job queued: nova12b-int6-sweep-2823456789 (job id jb-8207).
ops-bot: scheduled capacity-sim (sim id sim-4482).
rahul: thanks team. We should be able to present a recommendation to GTN after mona's 3k sweep.
